title: Shared Interactive Workspace and capability-driven application interaction
decision: Materialize one provider-neutral shared interaction layer for typed natural-language actions, generative workspace projection, review/revision, skill/runtime surface composition and semantic appearance. Reuse existing FA3 authorities and MMG Context IR; do not create a parallel Prompt IR, provider/model router, MCP authority or durable orchestrator.
user_request_ref: 2026-10-03 conversation: owner approved the donor-backed Shared Interactive Workspace plan and instructed completion through closure.
